note: biomes/line's adapter onto the material library (core/materials/PLAN.md; biomes/line/PLAN.md section 13). The bore station (stations/bore): the lining (85-host-lining.js) on concrete.ancient until the owed concrete.lining.segment comes (PROMPTS-NEEDED.md section 41); the guideways on concrete.board until concrete.guideway comes; the invert, strip, footway and barrier on concrete.slab; the access road on ground.asphalt; the walkway's grating, the handrail and posts, the Fixers' patches on the rusty grate and plate; the bronze bands; the enamel plates and the road's line on chipped paint; the spoil on demolition rubble; rock.riftfill is the KGROUND layer on the rock where it shows (84-host-rock.js: the niches, the vein's gallery). Scales are world metres per tile; the builder writes UVs in metres. Run python3 tools/textures/pack.py biomes/line after any change, then python3 build.py.

conc.note: the invert, the central strip, the footway, the barrier

metal.note: the handrail, the posts, the slot's lips, the Fixers' plate

bronze.note: the bands where the structure transfers

paint.note: the enamel plates, the road's line

rock.riftfill.note: the rift fill where the lining opens (KGROUND)

rock.granite.note: the granite of the hot door (km 54-57) where the lining opens (KGROUND)

rock.breccia.note: the impact breccia of the fault (km 33-53) where the lining opens (KGROUND)
